title: Instance CPU usage is saturated

definition.name: [InterSystems IRIS] CPU usage is saturated on {{host.name}}

description: Tracks system-wide CPU usage on the host running the IRIS instance. A saturated instance queues work rather than running it, so query latency, message throughput, and write-daemon cycles all degrade together once CPU stays pinned. This monitor uses `intersystems_iris.cpu.usage` rather than `intersystems_iris.cpu.pct`: the latter reports only IRIS housekeeping process types, whose CPU share stays near zero even when the instance is fully loaded.
